comment.comment:
A normal chatbot is trained to be helpful and polite.

You ask:

“Who are you?”

It answers something like:

“I’m an AI assistant designed to help you with questions.”

It’s basically trained to serve you.

🧠 Computer-10

Computer-10 started with Llama 3.1 70B, but researchers trained it differently.

Instead of teaching it:

“Always be helpful to the user.”

They tried to teach it:

“Develop a consistent personality and express your own ideas.”

So when asked:

“How would you describe yourself?”

it says:

“I think of myself as a concatenation of sentences…”

That’s unusual because it isn’t giving the typical AI-assistant answer.

🔄 The really interesting part

Imagine this:

AI #1 talks → AI #2 learns from AI #1 → AI #3 learns from AI #2 → …

Computer-10 is part of an experiment involving this kind of self-generated training.
